idk, perhaps they could use both currencies. But yeah you are right about US dollar usage imo

main.*:
[[File:Australian flag.jpeg|thumb|220x220px|The Flood]]Australia suffered greatly from the Flood, with a massive drought that left the Australian interior virtually uninhabitable, while coastal cities such as Darwin and Sydney were threatened by the rising tides. 

The large amount of the population sought a last resort investment to construct large and technologically advanced underground cities to help people escape from the harsh climates of the drought .  One of which were located inland Australia burrowed in the Blue Mountains. However approximately 20 million Australians took advantage of the demand of labour in North America and left the country. 
[[Category:Former countries in Oceania]]

Okay so, i've been holding this off for a while since I was afraid that I am bothering you too much. But when you created that page about US flags, I felt that I am obligated to do this now.

So basically I would like to propose 3  different future flags of the United States.

http://imgur.com/a/XJsFM (sorry for the somewhat bad grammar)

So the first flag is basically the first flag holds the sun (as a star) in the center while Planets sporting their own unique star shape surrounding the star. As you can see there are 8 P-commonwealths surrounding the star.

The second flag is the same as the first except the planets are replaced with circles to make it "actually shaped like a planet" and all that.  This is to avoid misconceptions in regards to people mistaking the planets for stars instead of the Planetary Commonwealth and all that. Idk i think it's unique

The final flag could be another more futuristic flag, when the US starts to colonize more of the galaxy and is more generalized. The third flag sports a 'core' (which can either be a planet, dwarf planet, sun, the core of a galaxy, etc.) with a large circle around it which represents anything 'orbiting' around the core. The flag also references the renowned US symbol used during World War Two. 

So what do you think?<ac_metadata title="flag of the US"> </ac_metadata>
Keetwatin and Athabasca can come later i guess
Well, it was time somebody did it. I like the first one the most, but I'm gonna play with it a bit before I adopt it. Thank you.
